angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 577,431 km at 163.42 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1193 +/- 0.0203 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 163.42 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.83 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 577,431 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.81 +/- 0.15 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5545 +/- 33 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-41.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.508, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-41 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.06 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-41 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.19512, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-41 (pscomppars): age 1.2 Gyr, from Southworth et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.457.4205S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-41 (pscomppars): rotation period 18.41 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
